metadata.name: A1
metadata.description: label: B1 is the PUBLIC supabase config as ONE dict — sb.default derives from it by formula, so editing B1 repoints the whole app

metadata.name: B1
metadata.description: the appkit project's PUBLIC config {url, anonkey} — the local Supabase CLI stack + its shared publishable key (browser-safe by design; the xAI key stays server-side in the edge function). JSON data entry: the cell's VALUE is the dict.

metadata.name: sb.default
metadata.description: the config cel sbConfig resolves FIRST — derived from the visible B1 dict (reference IS the dependency: edit B1 and every supabase call follows)

metadata.name: A2
metadata.description: label: B2 mints a chat bot by GENESIS — delete the formula and the sweep retires the bot

metadata.name: B2
metadata.description: =addbot mints grok.roster.advisor {name, persona, model}; '@advisor …' in the chat routes a message to it

cels.f: =addbot("advisor", "Terse workbook advisor. You answer with the cleanest formula or the shortest correct sentence.", "")

metadata.name: A3
metadata.description: label: B3 IS the chat — one =view formula grows the pane; the login card gates it until signedIn(sb.default.auth)

metadata.name: B3
metadata.description: the whole chat as ONE visible formula: =view opens the pane, chatpane renders login-gate → transcript bubbles → composer; every referenced cel (transcript, question, bots, auth) re-renders it through the graph

cels.f: =view("chat", chatpane(grok.transcript, grok.question, {project:"default", authed:signedIn(sb.default.auth), bots:grok.bots, bot:grok.bot, email:grok.email, password:grok.password, status:grok.status}))

manifests.name: chatdoc
manifests.description: grok chat (a sheetapp document) — log in to Supabase and talk to grok about the workbook. The recipe is three visible cells: B1 the public config dict (sb.default derives from it), B2 =addbot mints a bot, B3 =view(chatpane(…)) grows the login-gated chat pane. Replies can READ and WRITE cells through the user's own commit path, receipted in the transcript.
